verdict.rationale: Gemini documents persistent personalization from the memory of past chats (gemini-docs-18). Custom Gems let users save instructions and requirements (gemini-docs-9), and notebooks remember instructions across a continuous chat (gemini-docs-11). However, Gems and notebooks are scoped containers, and the pack never shows a global custom-instructions or preferences setting that applies to every response. Missing for 10: a documented account-wide custom instructions/preferences setting, evidence that it applies to all chats, controls for editing saved preferences, independent or hands-on corroboration.
